items.headline: IBM reported second-quarter 2026 results and said it will hold its quarterly conference call on July 22, 2026; reported figures and updated outlook were weaker than analyst expectations, with coverage describing the reaction as mixed and the stock under pressure.

Coverage following IBM’s Q2 release says the company missed on adjusted EPS and revenue, and that full-year revenue guidance was lowered to roughly $70.2 billion to $70.9 billion, which weighed on sentiment despite investor focus on AI and quantum initiatives.
